title: Item:Mysterious Remnant Boost
wikitext:
__NOTOC__
{{Top}}
These potions increase the {{Item|Mysterious Remnant}}s you get in quests defeating [[Monster Champion]]s.

The timer pauses while in public area or logged out.

Mysterious Remnant Boost are bound to account. 

Mysterious Remnant Boost can be acquired from {{Item|Traveler's Terrific Trunk}}, [[Daily Dice]] reward options since [[Update 38 Patch 1#Daily Dice|Update 38 Patch 1]]
